legal_status_meanings.verified: The behavior-to-category mapping, applicable provision, and reference penalty have been checked against authoritative sources and are approved for active use.

No Helmet.official_category_proposed: Unauthorized or Non-Use of Helmet by Motorcycle Riders
unresolved_elements: Applicable scope not verified — verify whether the category legally covers all rider scenarios.
Do NOT extend verified coverage to unfastened or noncompliant helmets merely because the same broad label appears relevant.
behavior_details: Motorcycle with an associated rider (person within RIDER_ASSOCIATION_PADDING of motorcycle bbox) with no helmet of any kind detected.
Requires model classes: motorcycle, person, helmet_acceptible, helmet_nut_shell (or alternate acceptable set).
No Helmet.notes: Detector-only behavior; legal verification pending. Separate from Substandard/Nut-Shell Helmet.
